locator.text: Display 43.5, p. 43, in the statement of Lemma 4.9

provenance.note: machine audit: worker, gate, reviewer; not confirmed by a human

verdicts.summary: Lean uses a different formula here. The conclusion — strict positivity of all four admissible-cone components for the final triple, at every sufficiently large frequency — is proved, but not by the paper's formula. The cone condition is the four-conjunct predicate InTrueCone p₁ p₂ A C, which matches the paper's (4.35) componentwise under A = a, C = -b, t = -b/a (A(1+(C/A)²) = v, p₁ + p₂(C/A) = c, p₂ - p₁(C/A) = j, and coneBound is the paper's U(c,j)), except that the paper's fourth component 2(c-v)² - (v-2)j² is replaced by the direct inequality v < coneBound(c,j) and the paper's c - v > 0 by 2 < c. In the repair chain I traced — profiles_trueCone (1309) → repaired_trueCone_of_bounds (546) → nominal_stockShear_stable (525) → compact_periodic_stockShear_stable (254) — there is no Ψ map and no margin arithmetic: instead of a Lipschitz constant C_Ψ and the margins μ_R/2 and μ_R/4, positivity after the repair comes from a compactness stability radius. compact_periodic_stockShear_stable obtains ρ > 0 from exists_cthickening_subset_open applied to the compact image of the cone data in the open cone (line 276), so four-coordinate perturbations of size ≤ ρ keep the triple in the cone; nominal_stockShear_stable is its instance, and exists_integer_frequency then chooses N with C/n ≤ ρ (ModulatedCone.lean:583, 597). The paper's explicit threshold N ≥ 4C_Ψ C_rep/μ_R, stated in the sentence just above the display, is therefore not stated: the Lean threshold N is existential, the chain of two inequalities is not verified as written, and only its endpoint Ψ_i > 0 is. The Lean does have the margin notion, just not here: HasConeMargin ε p₁ p₂ A C (TrueConeLoop.lean:283) is literally 'all four cone components exceed their thresholds by at least ε', the Lean's analogue of the paper's μ_L/μ_R, and compact_periodic_trueCone_margins (TrueConeLoop.lean:289-298) upgrades pointwise strict cone membership on a compact slow set with a periodic fast angle to one uniform positive ε. Its only consumer is exists_compact_trueCone_family_with_margin (TrueConeLoop.lean:765-798, call at line 790), which applies it to the nominal loop family (A, C) over the slow parameters K; neither name occurs in ModulatedCone.lean, so the margin is never carried onto the repaired triple (a_f, b_f, p_f), and the repaired cone membership is re-derived from the stability radius instead.
